constraints.definition: CHECK ((((octet_length(redirect_uri) >= 1) AND (octet_length(redirect_uri) <= 128)) AND (redirect_uri ~ '^http://127[.]0[.]0[.]1:([1-9][0-9]{0,4})/callback$'::text) AND COALESCE((((("substring"(redirect_uri, '^http://127[.]0[.]0[.]1:([1-9][0-9]{0,4})/callback$'::text))::integer) >= 1) AND ((("substring"(redirect_uri, '^http://127[.]0[.]0[.]1:([1-9][0-9]{0,4})/callback$'::text))::integer) <= 65535)), false)))
constraints.name: ga_attempts_redirect_check

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((phase = 'created'::text) AND (registration_admitted_at IS NULL) AND (client_id IS NULL) AND (code_admitted_at IS NULL)) OR ((phase = 'registration_admitted'::text) AND (registration_admitted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (client_id IS NULL) AND (code_admitted_at IS NULL)) OR ((phase = 'registered'::text) AND (registration_admitted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (client_id IS NOT NULL) AND (code_admitted_at IS NULL)) OR ((phase = ANY (ARRAY['code_admitted'::text, 'enrolled'::text])) AND (registration_admitted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (client_id IS NOT NULL) AND (code_admitted_at IS NOT NULL)) OR (phase = 'closed'::text)))
constraints.name: ga_attempts_stage_check

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((phase = 'enrolled'::text) AND (outcome_code IS NOT NULL) AND (outcome_code = 'enrolled'::text)) OR ((phase = 'closed'::text) AND (outcome_code IS NOT NULL) AND (outcome_code = ANY (ARRAY['cancelled'::text, 'expired'::text, 'host_revoked'::text, 'dependency_unknown'::text, 'registration_unknown'::text, 'code_unknown'::text, 'enrollment_unknown'::text, 'restart_denied'::text, 'refused'::text]))) OR ((phase <> ALL (ARRAY['enrolled'::text, 'closed'::text])) AND (outcome_code IS NULL))))
constraints.name: ga_attempts_outcome_check

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((client_id IS NULL) = (enrollment_id IS NULL)) AND ((client_id IS NULL) OR (registration_admitted_at IS NOT NULL)) AND ((code_admitted_at IS NULL) OR ((registration_admitted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (client_id IS NOT NULL)))))
constraints.name: ga_attempts_admission_check

constraints.definition: CHECK (((client_id IS NULL) OR (((octet_length(client_id) >= 1) AND (octet_length(client_id) <= 256)) AND (client_id !~ '[--]'::text) AND (client_id = btrim(client_id)))))
constraints.name: ga_attempts_client_check

constraints.definition: CHECK (((enrollment_id IS NULL) OR (("substring"((enrollment_id)::text, 15, 1) = '7'::text) AND ("substring"((enrollment_id)::text, 20, 1) = ANY (ARRAY['8'::text, '9'::text, 'a'::text, 'b'::text])))))
constraints.name: ga_attempts_enrollment_uuid_check

constraints.definition: CHECK ((isfinite(created_at) AND isfinite(expires_at) AND isfinite(updated_at) AND (expires_at > created_at) AND (updated_at >= created_at) AND ((registration_admitted_at IS NULL) OR (isfinite(registration_admitted_at) AND (registration_admitted_at >= created_at) AND (registration_admitted_at <= expires_at))) AND ((code_admitted_at IS NULL) OR (isfinite(code_admitted_at) AND (code_admitted_at >= created_at) AND (code_admitted_at <= expires_at) AND (code_admitted_at >= registration_admitted_at))) AND ((finished_at IS NULL) OR (isfinite(finished_at) AND (finished_at >= created_at) AND (updated_at = finished_at))) AND ((phase <> 'enrolled'::text) OR (finished_at <= expires_at))))
constraints.name: ga_attempts_time_check

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((octet_length(deployment_id) >= 1) AND (octet_length(deployment_id) <= 512)) AND (deployment_id !~ '[--]'::text) AND (deployment_id = btrim(deployment_id)) AND ((octet_length(tenant_id) >= 1) AND (octet_length(tenant_id) <= 512)) AND (tenant_id !~ '[--]'::text) AND (tenant_id = btrim(tenant_id)) AND ((octet_length(owner_user_id) >= 1) AND (octet_length(owner_user_id) <= 512)) AND (owner_user_id !~ '[--]'::text) AND (owner_user_id = btrim(owner_user_id))))
constraints.name: ga_attempts_scope_check

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.name: ga_attempts_owner_fkey

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((octet_length(issuer) >= 1) AND (octet_length(issuer) <= 2048)) AND (issuer ~~ 'https://%'::text) AND (issuer !~ '[--]'::text) AND (issuer = btrim(issuer))))
constraints.name: ga_attempts_issuer_check
